cohort: The study included delivery hospitalisations among women aged 18 years or older from the 2016-2022 United States National Inpatient Sample, categorized by the presence of IBD, CLD, both, or neither.
finding: Coexisting inflammatory bowel disease and chronic liver disease confer compounded maternal and perinatal risks beyond either condition alone.
mod_finding: Coexisting IBD and CLD were associated with higher odds of caesarean delivery compared to IBD or CLD alone.
